author: Mohd Haider
title: Why Is QuantumScape (QS) Stock Trending After Hours - NewsBreak
text:
By Mohd Haider ,
48 minutes ago Photo Courtesy: JHVEPhoto on Shutterstock.com QuantumScape Corp. (NASDAQ: QS ) shares are trending Thursday night.
Shares of the California-based energy storage company that develops solid-state lithium-metal battery technology edged 0.33% higher to $4.24 in after-hours trading on Thursday as investors weighed fresh analyst price target cuts ahead of the company’s third-quarter report.
Wall Street Trims Targets On Thursday, Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS ) analyst Andrew Percoco cut his price target on QuantumScape to $5 from $9 and kept an Equal-Weight rating , which signals the stock is expected to perform in line with the broader market.
Earlier this week, Evercore ISI Group analyst Chris McNally lowered his target to $7 from $10 and held an In-Line rating. That rating carries a similar meaning.
Q3 Earnings Are the Next Test The cuts follow QuantumScape’s announcement last week that it will report third-quarter results after the market close on Wednesday, Oct. 21.
Trading Metrics, Technical Analysis QuantumScape has a market capitalization of about $2.62 billion. Over the past 52 weeks, its stock has traded as high as $18.56 and as low as $3.80.
QS has a Relative Strength Index (RSI) of 34.95.
Over the past 12 months, the mid-cap stock has fallen 76.30%.
Price Action: The gain in the late trading session follows an intraday jump of 7.63% where the stock closed at $4.23, according to Benzinga Pro data.
